treatment.label: Oncology specialty patients
treatment.note: Patients recorded in specialty 65 (oncology), not all cancer patients or patients treated on time. Source area definitions and boundary timing are not fully verified; do not rank counties or combine with screening cohorts.

mortality.label: Cancer deaths (C00–C97)
mortality.note: Annual counts, not age-standardised rates. The strategy gives a rounded national reference of 13,300 deaths (10% lower is 11,970), not county-specific reduction baselines. Source uses 2026 county boundaries.

survival.label: Lung cancer five-year survival · women
survival.note: Five-year relative survival, age-standardised to the national patient age distribution. Lung cancer only; sexes are separate. Pancreatic/liver county results and a matching Nordic strategy benchmark are still missing, so the complete goal cannot be scored.

survival.label: Lung cancer five-year survival · men
survival.note: Five-year relative survival, age-standardised to the national patient age distribution. Lung cancer only; sexes are separate. Pancreatic/liver county results and a matching Nordic strategy benchmark are still missing, so the complete goal cannot be scored.

preventable-cancers.label: HPV vaccination · girls, two doses by age 13
preventable-cancers.note: Girls turning 13 in the reporting year who received two HPV doses during the preceding two school years. The API total series is the total within this girls-only indicator, not both sexes. Vaccination coverage is a supporting prevention indicator, not a count of cancers prevented.

preventable-cancers.label: HPV vaccination · boys, two doses by age 13
preventable-cancers.note: Boys turning 13 in the reporting year who received two HPV doses during the preceding two school years. The API total series is the total within this boys-only indicator, not both sexes. Small cells may be withheld. Vaccination coverage does not measure cancers prevented.

preventable-cancers.label: Daily smoking · age 20+
preventable-cancers.note: Self-reported daily smoking among people aged 20 and over. Survey estimates use nonresponse weights; uncertainty and coverage affect comparisons. This is a supporting risk-factor indicator, not a count of preventable cancer cases.

preventable-cancers.label: Excess alcohol use (AUDIT-C) · alcohol users age 20+
preventable-cancers.note: AUDIT-C probable excess use among alcohol users aged 20 and over. Thresholds differ by age and sex. These are self-reported, weighted survey estimates. The denominator is alcohol users, not all residents; this is not a count of preventable cancers.
